findings.topic: Why the other 87 controls are identical
findings.evidence: When keep_box equals actual query_box, _advance and the search control initialize the provider from the same parent.search_box and pass the same box and image dimensions. Provider.update ignores confidence and uses the same clipping/validity rules, so both search states are identical even when the proposed box is rejected. Motion substitution writes identical coordinates while retaining actual time and quality. All four post-query inference states therefore coincide; this is a source consequence of existing observed equality, not 87 new NN rollouts or measured new future outcomes.

The probe preserves actual per-control output, search, motion, writes and GT arrays and H3/H32 outcomes. The documented motion array semantics distinguish query commit from later forecast references. Query search/motion difference flags select the correct component rows. Single-event event_summary has unit weight; the revised plan makes no 24-event gain or population bootstrap claim. The launcher requires this source PASS, runs one GPU0 query, requires process success/COMPLETE/one differing query, and writes sanity_execution only after success. Runtime assertions must still execute before any runtime acceptance.
